children: The CONTRACTOR and the SUBCONTRACTOR referred to collectively as {b:PARTIES} and, individually, as {b:PARTY}.

children.name: text
children: On 30th May 2016, the CONTRACTOR entered into a construction contract (the ”MAIN CONTRACT”) with Femern A/S (the ”OWNER”) in connection with the Owner’s procurement of the construction of a fixed rail and road link across the Fehmarn Belt (the ”PROJECT”). The MAIN CONTRACT comprises the Tunnel North Contract, the Tunnel South Contract and the Tunnel Portal and Ramps Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall under the Tunnel Portal and Ramps Contract inter alia design and construct the cut-and-cover parts, the portal buildings, the ramps and light attenuation structures of the tunnels and certain installation, building and landside civil engineering works (the ”TUNNEL PORTAL AND RAMPS”).

children.name: text
children: The CONTRACTOR will subcontract works and services in connection with the {PackageName} (hereinafter referred to as the “SUBCONTRACT WORKS”)

children.name: text
children: The SITE is located east of the city of Ródbyhavn, Full address; Færgevej 40, 4970 Rödbyhavn, Denmark.

children.name: text
children: NOW IT IS AGREED that the SUBCONTRACTOR shall execute the SUBCONTRACT WORKS in accordance with this SUBCONTRACT including the CONDITIONS OF MINOR SUBCONTRACT as detailed overleaf and the SUBCONTRACT DOCUMENTATION as indicated below for the SUBCONTRACT PRICE of {SubcontractorOrderValue} (amount in words) including all taxes (normally excluding VAT), fees and duties, which shall be {SubcontractSumValued}.

children.name: text
children: In this Subcontract, all words and expressions have the same meaning as in the Main Contract, unless otherwise provided or where the context otherwise requires.

children.name: text
children: a) “Main Contract” means the contract between the Contractor and Femern A/S.

children.name: text
children: b) “Owner” means Femern A/S of Vester Søgade 10, DK-1601 Copenhagen V, Denmark.

children.name: text
children: c) “Works” means the Main Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: d) “Subcontract” means the subcontract agreement, the Conditions of Minor Subcontract including Annex A and Annex B together with any other Subcontract Documentation referred to herein.

children.name: text
children: e) “Subcontract Works” means the works to be carried out under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out, complete and maintain the Subcontract Works set out in the Contract Agreement in accordance with the Contractor’s instructions and shall keep confidential the nature of this Agreement and / or project related matters. The Subcontractor shall seek Contractor approval prior to publication of any information in any public domain and shall contact the Contractor’s Communications Department for all such approvals through communication@flc-jv.com

children.name: text
children: All employees of the Subcontractor and equipment entering the site shall comply with the Contractor’s quality, health, safety, environmental and security regulations and the Subcontractor shall bear the cost of his employees complying with such regulations including attendance at site inductions, safety briefings, prestart task briefings and the provision of all Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). The Subcontractor shall provide method statements and/or risk assessments.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract Works shall be free from defects and imperfections and the Subcontractor shall rectify any defect therein.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out ordered Subcontract Works efficiently and well planned and in accordance with the Contractor’s instructions. The price for ordered Subcontract Works shall be calculated in accordance with the rates/prices contained in this Subcontract and if there is no such rate or price the parties shall negotiate a rate or price that is fair and reasonable and be so ordered through the Contractor’s Change Request template and added to the Subcontract Price.

children.name: text
children: Materials and other supplies intended for incorporation in the Subcontract Works must be supplied by the Subcontractor without any retention of title.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out and complete the Subcontract Works according to the programme attached (if any) to this Subcontract. If no such programme is attached, the Subcontractor shall carry out the Subcontract Works according to the Contractor’s current Programme.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall copy all correspondences and communications associated with the Subcontract to the email correspondence address TPR-Contracts@flc-jv.com.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall promote the engagement of apprentices throughout the duration of the Subcontract Works and shall actively engage and comply with the Contractor’s Apprentice Coordinator in relation to all apprenticeship monitoring, recording and reporting.

children.name: text
children: Any delay of the scheduled Subcontract Works will not be accepted and delay damages will be applied according to the milestone date given in the programme at the rate of 0.1% of the Subcontract Price per calendar day of delay upto a maximum of 10% of the Subcontract Price.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is a member of either Dansk Industri, Dansk Byggeri or Dansk Erherv and will maintain membership until handover of the Subcontract works for their own legal entity and will promote membership to its sub-subcontractors.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall submit statements for payment seven (7) calendar days before the end of each month for the Contractor’s approval. Following such approval within 7 calendar days, the Subcontractor shall submit his invoice indicating the approved amount to FLC Portals Group I/S, Hedegaardsvej 88, DK-2300 Copenhagen S, Denmark (invoice@flc-jv.com) marked with the Invoice account number [to be provided by the Contractor].

children.name: text
children: The amount due shall be paid within 30 calendar days from the end of the month in which the invoice was received.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Denmark, excluding, however, Danish provisions on choice of law.

children.name: text
children: The language of the Subcontract shall be English.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with the requirements for staff and labour conditions Denmark [Annex A] and accommodation requirements [Annex B].

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with the Ten Principles of the UN Global Compact (as published by the UN Global Compact https://www.unglobalcompact.org/what-is-gc/mission/principles) effective as at the Agreement Date.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be liable for and shall pay all statutory taxes, duties, levies and charges resulting from the Subcontractor’s employment under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Without limiting the Subcontractor’s liability towards the Contractor, the Subcontractor has benefit of the Owner provided Construction All Risk and Third Party Liability Insurance. The Subcontractor is deemed to have full knowledge of this policy and will comply with all its conditions and requirements.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall effect and maintain with insurers acceptable to the Contractor all insurances required by law and necessary to discharge its obligations under the Subcontract including; a) Subcontractor’s equipment; b) workers’ compensation; c) workers’ balance of risk (“differencekrav”); d) motor vehicle; and e) other mandatory insurances. {br}Details of the aforementioned insurances shall be provided on request to the Contractor. In the event of the Subcontractor’s failure to effect such insurance, the Contractor may effect such insurance and recover the cost of so doing from the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may without further liability on himself terminate the Subcontract after having provided 7 calendar days’ written notice for any breach of these Subcontract conditions:

children.name: text
children: Upon such termination the Contractor or the party completing the Subcontract Works on behalf of the Contractor is entitled to use the Subcontractor’s equipment and materials present on the site if their removal before completion of the Subcontract Works would inflict a loss on the Contractor. Customary remuneration is payable for their use.

children.name: text
children: All disputes arising out of or in connection with this Subcontract shall be settled amicably by the Parties. If the Parties fail to reach an amicable agreement within 30 calendar days after having received a request from the other Party, either Party may refer the disputes to arbitration and such dispute shall be finally settled under the Rules of Arbitration of the Danish Building and Construction Arbitration Board by one arbitrator appointed in accordance with the said Rules. Arbitration shall take place in Copenhagen, Denmark and shall be conducted in English language.

children.name: text
children: The SUBCONTRACTOR shall (and ensure that all its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs shall) comply with the requirements of applicable Danish labour laws and regulations including the enactment and application of (a) the Convention No. 94 of 1949 of the International Labour Organisation (ILO 94) and (b) the Posted Workers Directive (Directive 96/71/EC) in relation to the engagement of any workers for carrying out any work in Denmark associated with this Agreement, extending (as of January 2021) in particular to the following requirements with respect to construction work:{br}

children.name: text
children: a minimum salary of DKK 131.15 per working hour (covering fixed salary elements only);

children.name: text
children: working time restrictions according to Danish legislation;

children.name: text
children: a 7.6 percent salary increment to cover payment for public holidays that do not fall on Sundays;

children.name: text
children: compensation for overtime pursuant to recognized levels in the most representative collective bargaining agreement;

children.name: text
children: vacation compensation of a minimum of 12.5 percent of the full salary paid to an eligible and independent agency (including independent agencies recognized in the country of domicile);

children.name: text
children: pension allowance of a minimum of 8 percent of salary paid to an eligible and independent agency (including independent agencies recognized in the country of work and of domicile); and

children.name: text
children: reimbursement for expenses associated with required home-trips of posted workers, including expenses required for accommodation and meals;{br}

children.name: text
children: in each case as such requirements may evolve over time, including any change in the requirements in applicable Danish labour laws and regulations, any change in any relevant EU legislation which is made applicable in Denmark as well as any change in agreements made by the most representative collective bargaining parties on the Danish labour market with respect to requirements recognized as normative (the requirements as updated from time to time being the "minimum requirements").{br}

children.name: text
children: With respect to workers performing services in Denmark other than construction work or workers being on a training program (apprenticeship), it is the duty of the SUBCONTRACTOR to identify the corresponding minimum requirements which are normative for the industrial sector or the form of engagement in question and ensure that such minimum requirements as updated from time to time are fully complied with.{br}

children.name: text
children: Compensation, salary increments and allowances paid in posted worker's homeland are normally recognized with due regard to international private law and subject to full verification of amounts and availability to the benefit of the individual worker according to rules recognized in the country of domicile.{br}

children.name: text
children: The SUBCONTRACTOR shall be responsible for ensuring that all of its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs of any tier comply with the minimum requirements.{br}

children.name: text
children: The SUBCONTRACTOR shall be responsible for ensuring that all workers engaged by it or its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs for carrying out work or services in Denmark in connection with the Project are informed about the conditions set forth in this Sub-Clause 6.1 [Labour Conditions Denmark].{br}

children.name: text
children: At the end of each month the Subcontractor shall, in respect of both its own workers and those of its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs of any tier, report to the Contractor how many posted workers there are working in Denmark in connection with this Agreement divided into different categories of work. The monthly report shall also include a confirmation by an authorized representative that the minimum requirements have been complied with and in case of any uncertainty a full explanation should be given together with a plan for removing the uncertainty. The SUBCONTRACTOR shall, in respect of both its own workers and those of its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs of any tier, provide such further information as is requested by the Contractor in order to demonstrate that it is complying with the minimum requirements including but not limited to pay-slips, payroll accounts and employment contracts for any worker carrying out any work in Denmark associated with the Agreement. The SUBCONTRACTOR shall in all cases redact any information concerning racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, or data concerning health or sex life from the supplied information in order to comply with the Act on Processing of Personal Data ("Persondataloven"). If the SUBCONTRACTOR does not provide the requested documentation within 10 Days, the Contractor is entitled to withhold amounts from its payments to the SUBCONTRACTOR until the SUBCONTRACTOR has provided the required documentation.{br}

children.name: text
children: The SUBCONTRACTOR bears the risk for labour conflicts in relation to workers employed by the SUBCONTRACTOR or its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs. As between the Contractor and the SUBCONTRACTOR, compliance by the SUBCONTRACTOR with the minimum requirements does not entitle it to any relief from its obligations if it nevertheless incurs costs or delay due to labour conflicts or other related matters.{br}

children.name: text
children: If the SUBCONTRACTOR fails to comply with the minimum requirements as updated from time to time and this results in a legitimate claim for additional payment or compensation from the workers, the Contractor may withhold payments to the SUBCONTRACTOR covering such additional payments and corresponding to this amount. The SUBCONTRACTOR shall in addition be liable to pay a penalty to the C Contractor corresponding to the amount required in order to meet the minimum requirements. A claim shall in all instances be considered legitimate if the Contractor obtains the opinion of the relevant employer organisations and labour organisations and they agree that the SUBCONTRACTOR has failed to comply with the requirements of this Sub­ clause 6.1. Example: If the worker has a legitimate claim of 1,000 Euro in additional payment (against the SUBCONTRACTOR or its Sub-SUBCONTRACTORs (as the case may be)), the Contractor may withhold payments to the SUBCONTRACTOR corresponding to this amount until the SUBCONTRACTOR (or Sub-SUBCONTRACTOR) has settled the legitimate claim and the SUBCONTRACTOR shall furthermore be liable to pay a penalty of an additional amount of 1,000 Euro.{br}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor reserves the right to terminate the Agreement for repeated or serious violations of these requirements related to labour conditions.

children.name: text
children: The SUBCONTRACTOR is required to provide accommodation for the SUBCONTRACTOR’s Personnel who cannot reasonably commute between the site and their private home, and

children.name: text
children: the accommodation used is of a standard equivalent to or better than the specific requirements outlined in Table 1 – {em:Specific Requirements};

children.name: text
children: the accommodation used is within reasonable commuting distance to the site; and

children.name: text
children: there is no adverse social and physical impact on communities, surroundings and infrastructure.

children.name: text
children: The SUBCONTRACTOR is required to include in the Monthly Progress Report

children.name: text
children: the number of SUBCONTRACTOR’s Personnel employed on site;

children.name: text
children: the number of SUBCONTRACTOR’s Personnel accommodated by the SUBCONTRACTOR at each address;

children.name: text
children: confirmation of the standard at each address, measured against the Table 1 - {em:Specific Requirements}.

children.name: text
children: The apartment for each employee shall be minimum 8.8 m2 fitted out as a single room, each with an individual small bathroom. Supplementary shower and toilet facilities may also be provided as shared facilities elsewhere, if deemed necessary by the SUBCONTRACTOR.

children.name: text
children: It must be ensured that the indoor noise level with closed windows and doors never exceeds the following limits:
Measurement of indoor noise in the living quarters of the accommodation Site shall be performed according to “Miljøstyrelsens vejledning nr. 6/1984 Måling af ekstern støj fra virksomheder”.

children.name: text
children: For the purpose of considering the extent of insulation, the SUBCONTRACTOR shall base its calculation on an outdoor noise level of 55 decibels.

In this connection, the SUBCONTRACTOR is made aware of that the outdoor noise level may significantly exceed 55 decibels up to 15 days per year for special recreation activities to be defined in the further planning.

The SUBCONTRACTOR will be asked to take these days into account in its planning so that workers not participating in the activities are ensured undisturbed rest through vacation planning or alternative accommodation.

children.name: text
children: The indoor temperature shall stay between 20 and 27 degrees Celsius all year (without opening the windows).
Smoke alarm and emergency light shall be provided and in compliance with applicable codes and regulations.
All apartments shall be fitted with either electronic card locks or key locks.

children.name: text
children: As a minimum the apartments shall be equipped with:

children.name: text
children: • ceiling lamp, bedside lamp, power sockets
• small bathroom – with toilet, sink, storage unit, mirror, hooks
• broadband internet. The access to the broadband internet shall be of sufficient capacity for the number of SUBCONTRACTOR’s Personnel living at the SUBCONTRACTOR’s accommodation.
